controllerType: Jack proprietary controller for flatseamer (绷缝机) with stepping motor
type: Stepping motor flatseamer / coverstitch machine (步进绷缝一体机)
source: JACK 8787 electric control instruction-stepmotor.pdf (Chinese-only training slide deck, 9 pages)
note: The Jack 8787 is a flatseamer (coverstitch/chainstitch) machine with a servo main motor and a single stepping motor that drives three mechanisms via cam: thread cutter (剪线), presser foot lift (抬压脚), and thread loosener (松线). This makes it 'one motor drives three' (步进电机结构一拖三). The PDF is a Chinese-only training deck, not a full English manual. Parameter descriptions are translated from Chinese.

specs.motorType: Servo main motor + stepping motor for trim/lift/loosen
stepperMotorAdvantages: Ultra quiet: very light thread cutting sound
Adjustable thread cutting: stroke and speed configurable
Adjustable presser foot height: max 10mm, speed configurable

panel.type: LCD display with 12 buttons and status indicator lights

buttons.name: Right (>)
buttons.function: Navigate parameter right / enter function select

buttons.name: Presser foot
buttons.function: Presser foot lift. Long press 3s: fast entry to P110 (presser foot stroke parameter)

buttons.name: Scissors (trim)
buttons.function: Thread cutting. Long press 3s: fast entry to P105 (thread cutting angle parameter)

parameterEntry.userParams: Press P to enter parameter mode; navigate with Left/Right; adjust with +/-; confirm with OK
parameterEntry.technicianParams: Long press P key then press - key → display shows '0000' → enter password 2014 → press OK → navigate to parameter → press OK to enter
shortcuts: Long press scissors key 3s → P105 (thread cutting angle)
Long press presser foot key 3s → P110 (presser foot stroke)
parameterEntry.machineTypeSelection: Parameter P88 selects flatseamer machine type (绷缝机机型选择)

troubleshooting.solution: Long press P then press - → display shows 0000 → input password 2014 → press OK → navigate to parameter → press OK to enter.

troubleshooting.cause: Physical adjustment and/or parameter adjustment needed
troubleshooting.solution: Physical: Adjust M5 screw on the stepping motor lever assembly. Electronic: Long press scissors key 3s to fast-enter P105 (thread cutting angle parameter).
Long press presser foot key 3s to fast-enter P110 (presser foot stroke parameter). Max presser foot height is 10mm.
